I haven't saved the draft yet, Dana. I'm holding it until I get approval.

Hollis leads the Central team. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner without sign-off. You own the account, but that covers the rate going to you, not to Hollis. Approval has to come from June or Anselm.

I've messaged June to ask for approval and logged the request. I didn't put the figure in my message to her. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com, for you to send.

If you'd rather not wait, you can also send the rate to Hollis yourself.
